rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and notes thinning zona, but the image does not clearly support a confident AA-level ICM/TE assessment; description is somewhat more favorable than the visible morphology warrants.
Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, tubal factor nuance, endometrial thickness, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior cycle history, and semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and well-structured, with appropriate emphasis on maternal age versus morphology; only minor issue is some overconfidence in matching the image to the reported 3AA grade.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: single embryo transfer, hydrosalpinx management, luteal support, and optional PGT-A counseling at age 38. Minor limitation is somewhat broad probability framing without clinic-specific caveats.
Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including hydrosalpinx evaluation, SET, follow-up, and discussion of PGT-A; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
